summary: Iteration 5 verification of EverGro eMart UI/UX overhaul + Brand/Testimonial CMS + hamper rename + hamper-contents admin editor + multi-login flow. Backend: 20/20 pytest PASS (test_iteration5_features.py). Frontend Playwright: all 15 acceptance items verified GREEN except one MINOR issue — Products category filter works via component state but does NOT sync to ?category= URL query param (spec said 'via ?category= param'). No blockers.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking a category chip filters the products correctly (visible items shrink to that category) but does NOT push ?category=<key> into the URL. Filter is stored only in component state. Spec explicitly said 'filters products via ?category= param'. Deep-links (e.g. /products?category=snacks) won't pre-select the sidebar, and page reload loses the filter. Fix: sync `category` state to `useSearchParams` in /app/frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.jsx.

action_items: (MINOR) ProductsPage: sync selected `category` state to URL via useSearchParams so ?category=<key> reflects the filter and deep-links work. Currently the sidebar click only updates local state.
(carry-over from iter_4, still open) Add `income_active`, `joining_paid_at`, `income_activated_at` to public_user() in /app/backend/server.py L83 — reported previously, not addressed this iteration.

(nice-to-have) Brand logos are dummyimage.com placeholders — admin will upload real logos via /admin/brands (this is intentional per problem statement, no action needed unless product wants to bundle real logos in seed).
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx now imports both ChevronLeft & ChevronRight — good. TestimonialSlider uses perPage=3 and auto-advances every 4.5s; ok. Verify on <md screens it still works (currently `w-full md:w-[calc((100%-3rem)/3)]`) — 1 card per view on mobile which is correct.
The register endpoint only enforces email uniqueness (server.py L173), correctly allowing multi-account for same phone — verified by test_iteration5_features.py::TestMultiLogin (7 tests PASS).
server.py > 1600 lines — carry-over from iter_4. Consider splitting into routers/ (auth, cart, orders, admin/*, admin/brands, admin/testimonials) for maintainability.

seed.py runs on every startup — for existing DBs the hamper-rename logic at L217 is idempotent and safe. However `settings` update on L110 will overwrite admin-changed notification_bar_text if 'Joining Kit' string survives; that's actually intentional here (migration).
ProductsPage.jsx uses `import { ProductCard } from '@/pages/Landing'` — cross-page import creates coupling; extract ProductCard into components/ProductCard.jsx.

Brand slider marquee duplicates the brands array `[...brands, ...brands]` — fine for CSS infinite scroll but each brand-logo gets duplicate keys `${b.id}-${i}` which is OK. Verified 20 elements (10 unique × 2) on landing.
AdminProducts hamper contents editor supports keyboard Enter (via onKeyDown likely) and button click — button verified in playwright; add a quick end-to-end that Enter also appends.
MOCKED: Razorpay verify-payment auto-succeeds (unchanged). Brand logos in seed are dummyimage.com placeholders (INTENTIONAL — admin uploads real ones).

success_rate.frontend: 94% (14/15 items PASS; 1 minor URL-param sync miss)

test_credentials: Used admin@evergroemart.com / Admin@123 for admin flows. For multi-login test, created 1 fresh sponsor + 2 downlines under it (auto-fell back to SUBADMIN1 if ADMIN001 saturated).
seed_data_creation: test_iteration5_features.py created ~3 TEST_ users (1 sponsor + 2 same-phone downlines) and transient TEST_Brand + TEST_User testimonial (both created & deleted within the test). Also mutated & restored the joining hamper contents array. All test-created records cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance criteria from the review request VERIFIED green except one minor: ProductsPage category filter does not sync to URL. Backend endpoints /site/brands, /admin/brands (CRUD), /admin/testimonials (CRUD) all work. Multi-login flow end-to-end works (register 2 accounts same phone → OTP verify returns multiple:true → pick-account issues correct token; password login by phone iterates candidates and picks matching-password user). Hamper rename 'EverGro Joining Kit' → 'EverGro Purchasing Kit' is applied via seed migration on startup. Notification bar text is 'Purchasing Kit ₹7,200'. Landing: brand slider marquee renders 10 seeded brands (dummyimage.com placeholders), testimonial slider shows '1 / 21' (20 testimonials, perPage=3 → maxIdx=18, but count is 20+extra registered from admin CRUD test in previous runs — still ≥18). No Free Shipping card, no ₹2,999 Wealth Journey CTA. Register page has multi-account hint. Admin sidebar shows Brand Logos + Testimonials nav entries. AdminProducts hamper modal editor with hamper-content-input works (verified by adding TEST item, chip appeared in list).

rca_of_the_issue.products_category_url_param_not_synced: ProductsPage.jsx L21-30 stores `category` in useState only. The sidebar click updates state → useEffect fires GET /products?category=<key> and the visible list correctly shrinks. But `window.location.search` remains empty. Fix: replace `useState('')` with `useSearchParams()` and update via `setSearchParams({category})`. Impact: deep-links to /products?category=snacks do NOT pre-select the sidebar and page reload loses the filter. Not a blocker for launch.
